text: This report provides information on the status of the Exhibition Place health and safety system, specifically on activities, priorities, and performance during the third quarter of 2020. There were 0 lost time injuries and a 100 percent decrease in the number of medical aid injuries in the third quarter of 2020 relative to 2019. Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) invoiced costs for third quarter 2020 were 19 percent higher than in third quarter 2019. An increase in Long Term Disability costs can be attributable to higher WSIB fees.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (November 24, 2020) from the Chief Executive Office, Exhibition Place for information.
